optimized_guidance.research_question: This work presents a simple yet effective approach for unlearning specific token sequences in large pretrained language models, providing empirical privacy guarantees.
optimized_guidance.method_change: We employ gradient ascent on the unlikelihood training objective to unlearn specific sequences, aiming for minimal degradation in performance.
optimized_guidance.experiment_change: We will conduct experiments to assess the impact of unlearning on model performance, particularly focusing on the trade-off between privacy and accuracy.
optimized_guidance.claim_boundary: The findings are primarily relevant to large language models and may not generalize to other machine learning contexts.
